image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a small dog, identified as a Blenheim spaniel (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel type), standing on a patterned red and yellow textile surface. The dog has a white coat with rich chestnut/red markings on its ears and head patches. It is looking downwards. The lighting creates strong shadows and highlights on the fur.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat is predominantly white with distinct chestnut/red patches on the head/ears and a large patch on the back.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture appears silky and straight rather than curly. Feathering is evident on the ears and legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: From the high angle, the body appears compact and proportionate to the head size, fitting the 'toy' description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The front legs appear straight. The hindquarters show feathering. No obvious bowing or structural deformity is visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.

This is a static image, so gait dynamics cannot be assessed.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The geometric pattern of the rug/cushion shows slight warping and inconsistency in line thickness near the bottom left, suggesting minor AI generation artifacts in non-subject areas.
The rear left leg blends slightly into the background shadow with less definition than the front legs, potentially indicating slight fusion or depth-of-field simulation issues common in AI images.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific breed classification and distinguish from similar spaniel breeds (e.g., English Toy Spaniel vs Cavalier).
To verify the skeletal structure of the limbs and spine, ensuring no extra limbs or impossible joint angles.
To check for edge bleeding between the fine ear fringes and the background, a common failure point in AI-generated fur.
To assess overall coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global artifacts.

focus_areas: Ear feathering integrity and separation from background
Symmetry and placement of facial features (eyes/nose)
Anatomical correctness of visible paws and legs
